document.name: Space Club Fort Greene Classes
document.shortDescription: Weekday morning parent-and-me style classes in Fort Greene for ages 1-5 with music, art, dance, and sensory play.
document.longDescription:
Space Club's official classes page describes classes for children ages 1 to 5 and highlights programming across music, art, dance and movement, playdoh, and sensory play. The same public page publishes a weekday class rhythm at 10 AM and 11 AM Monday through Friday.

The official location block for Fort Greene lists Space Club Fort Greene with email fortgreene@spaceclub.com and phone +1 (212) 812-2996. The class page positions the program as weekday child enrichment rather than a drop-in play space.

Sources: https://spaceclub.com/pages/classes https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0767/3505/4146/files/SpaceWebsiteClassTiles-02_fb3a5dcc-545a-4d09-8f08-3e9effd7086e.jpg?v=1712857726
